statements.sql:
INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'identity.credential-id', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM identity_auth_identity WHERE auth_identity_id = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'identity.credential-subject', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM identity_auth_identity WHERE realm_id = ? AND provider_id = ? AND subject = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'identity.user', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM identity_user WHERE realm_id = ? AND user_id = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'workspace.owner', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM workspace_workspace WHERE realm_id = ? AND owner_user_id = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'workspace.workspace', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT rev FROM workspace_workspace WHERE workspace_id = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO identity_user (user_id, realm_id, display_name, state, created_at, deletion_requested_at, rev)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1, CAST(? AS INTEGER), NULL, 1);

INSERT INTO identity_auth_identity (auth_identity_id, user_id, method, subject, public_key, user_handle, backup_eligible, backup_state, transports, sign_count, label, created_at, last_used_at, revoked_at, realm_id, provider_id, password_hash, rev)
VALUES (?, ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, ?, ?, NULLIF(CAST(? AS INTEGER), -1), NULLIF(CAST(? AS INTEGER), -1), ?, NULLIF(CAST(? AS INTEGER), -1), ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), NULL, NULL, ?, ?, ?, 1);

INSERT INTO workspace_workspace (workspace_id, realm_id, owner_user_id, name, data_region, protection_profile, state, created_at, rev)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1, CAST(? AS INTEGER), 1);

INSERT INTO platform_command (command_id, workspace_id, actor_ref, operation, request_hash, status, result_payload, result_rev, error_code, created_at, expires_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 2, ?, NULLIF(CAST(? AS INTEGER), -1), NULL, CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER));

INSERT INTO platform_outbox (outbox_id, aggregate_kind, aggregate_id, aggregate_rev, event_type, payload, workspace_id, correlation_id, causation_id, state, attempts, created_at, dispatched_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 0, CAST(? AS INTEGER), NULL);

INSERT INTO platform_outbox_position (outbox_id, stream_key, sequence)
VALUES (?, ?, (SELECT last_sequence FROM platform_sequence_stream WHERE stream_key = ?));

INSERT INTO platform_change_archive (archive_sequence, command_id, schema_version, record, record_hash, created_at)
VALUES ((SELECT last_sequence FROM platform_sequence_stream WHERE stream_key = 'platform:change-archive'), ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER));
DELETE FROM platform_command_guard WHERE command_id = ?;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'platform.recovery-current', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM platform_recovery_epoch WHERE realm_id = ? AND recovery_generation = CAST(? AS INTEGER) AND state = CAST(? AS INTEGER) AND rev = CAST(? AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'config.current-definitions-head', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM config_revision WHERE realm_id = ? AND config_revision_id = ? AND content_hash = ? AND state = 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'entitlement.workspace-revision', CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN rev > 0 THEN rev ELSE -1 END FROM entitlement_revision WHERE workspace_id = ?), 0) = CAST(? AS INTEGER) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO platform_command_guard (command_id, guard_key, allowed)
SELECT ?, 'entitlement.resolver-profile', CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entitlement_resolver_definition_profile WHERE realm_id = ? AND definitions_version = ? AND profile_hash = ? AND artifact_id = ? AND artifact_hash = ? AND artifact_length = CAST(? AS INTEGER) AND realm_kind = CAST(? AS INTEGER)) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

INSERT INTO entitlement_revision (workspace_id, rev, updated_at) VALUES (?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER))
ON CONFLICT (workspace_id) DO UPDATE SET rev = excluded.rev, updated_at = excluded.updated_at WHERE entitlement_revision.rev = CAST(? AS INTEGER);

INSERT INTO platform_command (command_id, workspace_id, actor_ref, operation, request_hash, status, result_payload, result_rev, error_code, created_at, expires_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 2, ?, NULLIF(CAST(? AS INTEGER), -1), NULL, CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER));

INSERT INTO platform_outbox (outbox_id, aggregate_kind, aggregate_id, aggregate_rev, event_type, payload, workspace_id, correlation_id, causation_id, state, attempts, created_at, dispatched_at)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 0, CAST(? AS INTEGER), NULL);

INSERT INTO platform_outbox_position (outbox_id, stream_key, sequence)
VALUES (?, ?, (SELECT last_sequence FROM platform_sequence_stream WHERE stream_key = ?));

INSERT INTO platform_change_archive (archive_sequence, command_id, schema_version, record, record_hash, created_at)
VALUES ((SELECT last_sequence FROM platform_sequence_stream WHERE stream_key = 'platform:change-archive'), ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER));
DELETE FROM platform_command_guard WHERE command_id = ?;
